drawingCalloutMappingUnconfirmed.qualification: The drawing includes these numbers, but their precise feature mapping has not been visually verified; they are not claimed here as manufacturer terminal gauge.

inferredEditable.chartMappingQualification: A/B are overall width/contact-row span. C and lock-shape chart D are recorded drawing values; their assignment to particular internal features is an authored interpretation.
inferredEditable.functionalInteriorQualification: Under-roof channels clear the corresponding authored beam and rails. Internal clearance dimensions are functional estimates, not measured manufacturer mould dimensions.

opposedContactBranches.note: Original nominal two-branch sketch constrained by measured channel height, sheet width and nose radius. No source outline, edge, sampled section or surface is imported. Sheet width is along X; no wire/gauge reduction.

measuredLocalDetails.note: Independently constructed scalar planes and chamfers; no imported topology or supplier surfaces.
